# The Urlcade

> A self-hosted game-authoring API, delivered as a URL-encoded virtual
> console: build a cart as a plain JS object, encode it to bytes, and
> the resulting URL fragment *is* the game — decoded and run by a
> single self-contained HTML runtime. No server, no build step, no
> install, no account. Copy a link, the recipient gets the exact game.

## Build a cart

- [AUTHORING.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/AUTHORING.md): How to build a cart — the object shape, every field's meaning, the opcode table, the hook lifecycle, the map generators. Start here.
- [kernel.js](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/kernel.js): The actual `encodeCart`/`decodeCart`/opcode table/assembler/VM/compression — extracted verbatim from the runtime into one dependency-free file. Runs standalone under Node or any JS host: no browser, no network, no build step (`const K = require('./kernel.js')`).
- [fixtures.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/fixtures.md): Known-good (cart description → exact bytes → exact fragment string) examples generated by kernel.js. Check your own implementation against these directly — nothing here requires running anything.

## Play it / inspect it

- [Play](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/): The live runtime — five playable cartridges (Flappy Bird, a racer, a roguelike, a platformer, and a physics-based castle-crusher), and an INSPECT button on each that decodes and visualizes any cart (palette, sprites, tiles, map, entities, disassembled hooks) including ones you paste in yourself.
